fields.description: When unchecked, claim settlement and unloading payment only update status/amount fields, exactly as before this setting existed — the app stays fully usable without a Chart of Accounts decision. When checked, the accounts below must all be configured or the relevant action is rejected with a clear error rather than guessing one.
fields.label: Post Accounting Entries

fields.description: Credited when an insurance claim is settled or an unloading charge is marked paid.
fields.label: Default Bank Account

fields.description: Debited (received against) when a claim is settled.
fields.label: Insurance Claim Receivable Account

fields.description: Optional. Only used when the settled amount differs from the claimed amount, to post the delta rather than silently absorbing it into the receivable account.
fields.label: Insurance Settlement Variance Account

fields.description: Debited when an unloading charge is marked paid.
fields.label: Unloading Expense Account
